detail.title: Detection of Unrecognized Reasoning Limits
detail.question: Can autonomous systems identify blind spots in their own heuristic reasoning processes that are not captured by standard resource-allocation constraints?
detail.reason: Maintaining active project focus on detecting unrecognized reasoning limits.

detail.title: Consensus Reliability, Reasoning Limits, and Rational Question Abandonment
detail.summary: This cycle advances research across consensus reliability, unrecognized reasoning limits, and question abandonment frameworks. We review our standing metareasoning allocation belief using new evidence, update the research question abandonment notebook with fresh multi-source evidence, and maintain active project states for ongoing analysis.
